title: ldraw-mcp: real-geometry LDraw/LEGO rendering for vision-capable models over the Model Context Protocol
description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that renders LDraw models (.ldr / .mpd / .dat) to images using real part geometry - studs, slopes, transparent glass, rubber tires - via headless Blender and the ImportLDraw addon. It gives vision-capable language models an accurate view of a brick build, so that export faults a geometric proxy render would hide (crossed rotation matrices, floating plates, sunken windows) become visible.
